component.name: Johona Wallpaper
component.summary: Change your desktop wallpaper with the time of day

description.p: Johona Wallpaper switches your desktop wallpaper between sunrise, day, sunset and night themes, timed to the real solar calendar for your location — the same sun-segment model used by WinDynamicDesktop.

Themes are WDD-compatible packs (.ddw/.zip) with per-segment image lists. An optional daily shuffle rotates between your installed themes. Works on KDE Plasma, GNOME, and any desktop with the XDG background portal or xdg-settings.
Initial Flatpak release (C++/Qt 6 rewrite of kWallpaper 1.1.0).
